title: Executive Turntable: Tinashe Manager Simonne Solitro Launches New Company
summary: Also: MusiMap hires former UMG chief technology officer Ty Roberts, Mom+Pop brings on vp of digital marketing Daria Stachera and more.
contentText:
Music executive and artist manager Simonne Solitro launched MAD CREATIVE , an independent management and creative company. With her, she brings her longtime client Tinashe ahead of the release of her upcoming album, Popstar .

“The new venture brings Simonne’s experience across artist management, development and creative strategy under one roof with a focus on building lasting careers, meaningful creative partnerships and ideas that extend beyond traditional management,” a press release reads. — Chris Eggertsen

Ty Roberts was named chief commercial officer of MusiMap . Roberts co-founded Gracenote and previously served as Universal Music Group’s chief technology officer.

“From my first introduction to MusiMap, I was immediately impressed by the depth of versatility of its technology as well as its ability to understand music through emotion, context and cultural meaning,” Roberts said in a statement. “MusiMap has the potential to become an important intelligence layer for any business that uses music to engage audiences, from helping brands identify music that will resonate with potential customers, to enabling music companies and platforms to search, organize and recommend vast catalogs with greater precision.”

Patrick Zucchetta , chief revenue officer at MusiMap, said, “At MusiMap, we have spent years building technology that understands music through emotion, context and cultural meaning. This creates powerful commercial applications such as Light On , helping them develop focused strategies that connect with consumers on an individual and emotional level. With his experience scaling music technologies and building strategic partnerships, Ty Roberts will help us bring MusiMap’s platform to organizations around the world.” — Ariel King
